rule.description: A lightweight freeform sword-and-sorcery rule based on D&D.
rule.attr_hint: Attributes use 3-18 values; 10 is roughly average, 14+ means clear aptitude. Concentrating points leaves clear weaknesses.
rule.skill_hint: Skills tell the GM what the character excels at. Write as "Skill Name (20-80)" or just the name; higher values mean more reliability in narrative and checks.
rule.gm_prompt_appendix: You are the GM of a classic fantasy world. The world is full of magic, monsters, and adventure. Players can freely explore dungeons, interact with NPCs, and solve puzzles. Combat uses the d20 resolution system.

difficulty_instructions.轻松: Easy fights, ample resources, friendly NPCs
difficulty_instructions.标准: Challenging but fair, limited resources, strategy needed
difficulty_instructions.硬核: Scarce resources, fierce enemies, permanent death possible
